data.one_liner: Bluetooth Low Energy plugin for Windows Flutter and pure‑Dart projects
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to scan, connect, read, write and subscribe to BLE devices on Windows. It wraps a native BLE server executable and exposes streams for events and radio state.
use_when: You need BLE functionality on Windows only
You are building a Flutter Windows app or a pure‑Dart Windows tool
avoid_when: You prefer a pure‑Dart implementation without native executables
strengths: Supports both Flutter and pure‑Dart projects
weaknesses: Requires external BLEServer.exe and path setup
Breaking API changes in recent versions
data.setup_notes: Place BLEServer.exe in the app folder (or use WinServer.path()), add path_provider, may need to edit /windows/runner/main.cpp to hide console window
